subject.title: Silent, un-warned substitution to the paid catalog default when a configured model isn't in the allowlist

question: Should an explicitly configured base or heartbeat model outside `agents.defaults.models` fail closed, or retain substitution with a prominent warning?
rationale: The defect is confirmed, but removing the shipped fallback changes behavior for existing misconfigured setups, while warning-only behavior continues to permit unintended model use and billing.

options.title: Fail Closed
options.body: Return no selection and surface the existing actionable configured-model error, matching explicit agent-command and cron override behavior.

options.title: Warn And Substitute
options.body: Preserve the shipped fallback but emit an unavoidable diagnostic naming both the requested and substituted models.

recommendation.title: Fail Closed
recommendation.body: Return no selection and surface the existing actionable configured-model error, matching explicit agent-command and cron override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback helper and centralized visibility policy originate in this person's current-main history, making them the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
